title: Abdominal Pain
correct_orders: Order abdominal ultrasound or CT scan
Consider obtaining electrocardiogram (ECG) to rule out ischemic heart disease
should_avoid: Start broad-spectrum antibiotics without culture and sensitivity

rationale.Start broad-spectrum antibiotics without: This order should be avoided as it can lead to unnecessary antimicrobial use and contribute to antibiotic resistance.
rationale.CBC · Lipase · LFTs · UA: Narrow differential: biliary, pancreatic, UTI, medical.
rationale.CT Abdomen/Pelvis: High yield for appendicitis, diverticulitis, obstruction.
rationale.Antibiotics if indicated: Give before OR if sepsis or perforation suspected.

Reason(s) for visit: Abdominal Pain
History of present Illness:
A 22-year-old female presents to the emergency room with abdominal pain, lethargy, and vomiting x2 days. Her vomiting is non-bloody. Her abdominal pain is diffuse, which she rates as a 6/10. She also claims to have had an increased appetite prior to having these symptoms. She also claims that she’s been developing blurry vision, dizziness, and drowsiness. She also states that she is having increased urination
